newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL TIN EASES ON INITIAL SELLING, CURRENCY CONCERN.
newsitem.headline: KL TIN EASES ON INITIAL SELLING, CURRENCY CONCERN.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price eased two cents to finish at 14.32 ringgit ($5.43) a kg due to a large initial selling and concern over the ringgit's direction against the U.S. dollar, traders said.

The near-term trend depends on the performance of the London market, they said. Some light scattered buying was seen from Japan, Europe and Malaysia, traders said. Turnover was 151 tonnes against 206 on Wednesday.
The local price remained at par with the London market, traders said.
